caption:
Storm go three stripes.

adidas is Melbourne Storm's new Official Apparel Partner on a multi-year deal. It covers the NRL squad, the elite pathway teams and the academy. The new jersey debuts when the Storm open 2027 in Las Vegas.

Also on the board: Taittinger x Newcastle United, waterdrop x Sydney Sixers, CSP International x World Surf League, The R&A x Golf Australia / PGA of Australia and Dreamworld x Supercars.
